definitions.gloss: neckline; collar area; front of the neck
definitions.explanation: The area around the collar or neckline of a garment, or the part of the body near the throat that clothing covers. Also used in idiomatic expressions.

examples.japanese: {襟元|えりもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れている→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{襟元|えりもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暖|あたた}めた→暖める：01858_atatameru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I warmed my neck area with a scarf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{襟元|えりもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧⟦{整|ととの}えて→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: After neatly adjusting the neckline of my kimono, I checked my overall appearance in the mirror.

notes:
USAGE:
Important in kimono culture, where the way the {襟元|えりもと} is arranged reflects one's grooming and elegance. The expression {襟元|えりもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧ means to straighten one's collar, and figuratively to compose oneself or adopt a serious attitude.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {襟元|えりもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧ (to straighten one's collar; to compose oneself)
- {襟元|えりもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧ (neckline is open)
- {襟元|えりもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (to adjust one's collar)
